name: Aira
summary: AI-assisted B2B prospecting on a Europe-native company database, with meeting notes flowing into records automatically. The product is young and independent review coverage is thin, so test it against a concrete metric of your own.
best_for: European B2B sales teams that want AI-assisted prospecting and automatic meeting/CRM hygiene from a Europe-native database
skip_if: your market is primarily US/global (US-native databases cover it better), or you need a mature, battle-tested platform today
honest_knock: Young product, sharp focus: European B2B prospecting on a 65-million-company database with meeting notes flowing into records automatically. The honest checks: independent review coverage is still thin, so run your own two-week test against a concrete metric (meetings booked, admin hours saved) rather than trusting early-adopter buzz. And note that the money-back guarantee exists precisely so you can do that without risk.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, billed annually (€5,988 a year)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on aira.app/pricing; first read in this form 2026-10-10) Aira now sells one product on its pricing page: Aira Connect at €499 a month, billed annually (€5,988 a year). That includes all 14 markets, unlimited users, every CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and MS Dynamics), API and MCP access, and 1,000 companies synced to your CRM. Above that the page prints a flat rate: €28 a month per extra 1,000 companies from 1,001 to 50,000, and 'Contact sales' above 50,000 (read 15 October 2026; on 10 October we did not see the amount). The €149 per user a month plan we read in July and August is no longer on the pricing page, the homepage or the about page. A 5-day free trial is offered. Prices are in euros.

compare_with.name: Apollo or Aira's EU-native angle vs global tools
compare_with.why: US-centric databases wins on global breadth; Aira's bet is European data depth plus assistant workflows — test on YOUR territory
